assembly_notes: Four independent component slots form 81 complete structural combinations, multiplied by five well_count values for 405 raw combinations. The root part is always the moulded case; the cover is always a REVOLUTE child of the case on the rear hinge line and its local origin sits on that axis. closure adds zero or one extra part (revolute rocker or prismatic slider) on the front pocket; opening adds zero or one extra welled tray (front REVOLUTE fold-out tray, or a sector tray on a vertical REVOLUTE pivot under the case). The well field, rim seat, hinge line, latch pocket and auxiliary mounts are all derived from the selected case_form, and round_puck derives rear/front chord flats plus an inscribed well field so it hosts every well pattern, the hinge and the latch without a topology change. Every rotational joint is solved with mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate; the closed cover seat is solved with mate_planes against the real rim footprint. Captured hardware uses real bores, stubs, through slots, guide runners, bored thrust collars and clearances, so no allow_overlap is used anywhere. Every moving part keeps a real contact interface with its host in every pose: the cover and the front tray via bored thrust collars bearing on the knuckle faces, the push-latch rocker via pivot collars bearing on the pocket walls, the sliding latch via a moulded guide runner under its rail, the fan-out tray via its seat on the case underside, and the closed cover via the rim seat solved with mate_planes.

derived.expression: case_plan_w_m - 2 * wall_t_m - 2 * field_margin_m for rectangular forms; 1.414 * (puck_radius_m - wall_t_m - field_margin_m) for the puck
derived.name: well_field_w_m
derived.rationale: The host cuts a real recess whose plan matches the selected well pattern.

derived.expression: case_plan_d_m - 2 * wall_t_m - 2 * field_margin_m for rectangular forms; 1.414 * (puck_radius_m - wall_t_m - field_margin_m) for the puck
derived.name: well_field_d_m
derived.rationale: Shallow hosts turn the radial ring into an ellipse and shrink the fan radius.

derived.name: cavity_depth_m
derived.rationale: Recess depth follows the selected well depth, not a fixed magic number.

derived.name: lid_plan_w_m
derived.rationale: The cover closes over the case wall with a real clearance gap.

derived.name: lid_plan_d_m
derived.rationale: Depth grows only at the front: the cover is flush with the case at the hinge line, and the puck derives a disc plus a rear chord instead.

derived.name: cake_top_clearance_m
derived.rationale: The closed cover must clear every pressed cake.

derived.expression: sqrt(puck_radius_m**2 - rear_flat_y_m**2) for the puck; case_plan_w_m / 2 for the rectangular forms
derived.name: rear_span_m
derived.rationale: Half-width of real flat rear material available to the hinge hardware; the puck's rear chord flat is narrower than its diameter.

derived.name: knuckle_x_m
derived.rationale: Case knuckles move outboard with the plan width but stay inside the real rear face, as in the elongated fork.

derived.name: knuckle_len_m
derived.rationale: Knuckle length scales with the plan but never exceeds the rear chord.

derived.name: barrel_len_m
derived.rationale: The cover barrel fills the axial gap between the case knuckles with a real 0.8 mm clearance on each end; bored thrust collars of length collar_len_m carry the axial location against the knuckle faces.

derived.name: barrel_bore_r_m
derived.rationale: Real bore clearance replaces any captured-pin overlap allowance.

derived.name: pocket_front_y_m
derived.rationale: The puck derives a front chord flat so the pocket has a flat mouth.

derived.name: pocket_depth_m
derived.rationale: Pocket depth cuts through the front wall and adds a relief for the hardware.

derived.name: aux_hinge_y_m
derived.rationale: Front tray hinge line derives from the host plan and stays ahead of the cover.

derived.name: fan_pivot_y_m
derived.rationale: Vertical fan pivot derives from the host plan.

derived.name: aux_bore_r_m
derived.rationale: Auxiliary bore clearance for both the front hinge pin and the vertical post.

derived.expression: sqrt(puck_radius_m**2 - front_flat_y_m**2) for the puck; case_plan_w_m / 2 for the rectangular forms
derived.name: aux_span_m
derived.rationale: Half-width of real flat front material available to the auxiliary hinge; the puck's front chord flat is much narrower than its diameter.

derived.name: aux_barrel_len_m
derived.rationale: The front tray barrel fills the gap between the front knuckles with real axial clearance; bored thrust collars locate it against the knuckle faces.

derived.name: aux_well_count
derived.rationale: The auxiliary tray well row scales with the main multiplicity.

derived.name: aux_pan_across_m
derived.rationale: Auxiliary pans reuse the main pan module scaled to the auxiliary tray pitch.

multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: 4 <= well_count <= 12; pan_across_m = pan_fill_ratio * min(available pitch, field edge clearance) so the derived well field of every case_form hosts every N without leaving the recess or colliding with a neighbour.
multiplicities.name: well_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: orthogonal_grid: (cols, rows) = grid_shape(well_count); pitch = (well_field_w_m/cols, well_field_d_m/rows). radial_ring: angular pitch = 2*pi/well_count on the ellipse (ring_rx_m, ring_ry_m). fan_sector: angular pitch = fan_span_rad/well_count about the fan apex. Auxiliary trays derive aux_well_count = clamp(round(well_count/3), 2, 4).
